description: This file contains unit tests for polymorphic grain interfaces in an Orleans-based distributed system. It verifies interface inheritance, upcasting, factory methods, and complex inheritance scenarios involving grains implementing multiple interfaces.

classes.name: PolymorphicInterfaceTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying polymorphic grain interface behaviors in Orleans, including inheritance, upcasting, factory methods, and complex inheritance scenarios.

methods.name: Polymorphic_SimpleTest
methods.description: Tests basic polymorphic interface method calls on a grain implementing interface IA.

methods.name: Polymorphic_UpCastTest
methods.description: Verifies upcasting grain references through interface inheritance hierarchies and method accessibility.

methods.name: Polymorphic_FactoryMethods
methods.description: Tests factory methods returning polymorphic grain references with different interface types.

methods.name: Polymorphic_ServiceType
methods.description: Verifies a grain implementing multiple interfaces exposes all expected methods.

methods.name: Polymorphic_InheritedMethodAmbiguity
methods.description: Tests resolution of ambiguous methods in diamond inheritance scenarios.

methods.name: Polymorphic__DerivedServiceType
methods.description: Tests a complex scenario where a derived grain implements multiple interface hierarchies and verifies cross-casting and method accessibility.
